title: FrontendErrorReport
description: One aggregated browser error (PLAN §50.3). Contains no user data: no stack traces, no URLs with query strings, no identifiers. The server additionally redacts the message.

message.description: Short technical message (for example the error class and the failing module).

route.description: Dashboard route path without query or fragment.

count.description: Occurrences of this error since the last batch (1 when absent).
